items.title: An $11 Billion Fund Dumps These 2 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAtreides Management, an $11 billion fund, sold all of its Amphenol and Alphabet shares in the third quarter and more than doubled its stakes in Astera Labs and Meta Platforms. The Alphabet exit isn’t a clean one, since the fund held Alphabet call options with $688 million of notional value at Sept.

items.title: Astera Labs vs. Amphenol: Which Connectivity Stock Is the Better Buy?
items.summary: ALAB outpaces APH in stock gains and AI-driven growth, but APH's diversification and lower valuation make it the stronger connectivity bet.

items.title: Can Amphenol Afford Its $4 Billion Buyback?
items.summary: A reader of our Nov 10 look at whether Amphenol stock is really expensive asked for more on the stock. The price has barely moved since. Amphenol (APH) closed at $78.23 on Friday, Nov 13. That is 2.2% below where it stood when that piece ran. So rather than check the price again, this piece takes up the question the Oct 28 results left owners with: can Amphenol pay for everything it just promised.
